name: Pylontech → Set Cell Polling
description: Reading the cells adds one `bat` command per battery to every update. This action stops or resumes those commands at runtime. Cell polling is on at boot, and the action does nothing when no `cells` are configured.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the pylontech component.

config_entries.label: Enabled
config_entries.description: `true` reads the cells after each update, `false` skips them.
